g.text: Do we usually take milk with or without coffe, give me a test in python checking it
mkdir -p /tmp/t && cat > /tmp/t/test_coffee.py <<'EOF' import unittest # Illustrative data, not real survey results: replace with your own. # Share of coffee d…

I can't measure what "we" usually do, so the test below uses made-up order counts. It passes, but it only shows the code works, not that most people take milk. Replace the numbers with real data, such as your team's
